blocks.text: Faced with the seemingly insurmountable task of posting a “three-peat” for the Philippines at the Miss Grand International pageant, Reina Filipinas Angelica Lopez remains steadfast in her quest for the crown. Fueling her drive is her desire to be of service to others. “I have always believed that joining a pageant, I should serve a purpose to everyone else. And that’s why I’m here, kasi (because) I really want to be that inspiration and source of hope to everyone else out there,” she told Inquirer Entertainment in an interview before she flew to Thailand for the international competition.
